mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.product_name, p.product_title, p.main_image, p.image_list AS image_list_str, p.description, p.category_id, c.category_name, p.merchant_id, m.merchant_name, m.origin_place AS merchant_origin_place, p.pre_sale_start, p.pre_sale_end, p.estimated_ship_date, p.season_tag FROM biz_product p LEFT JOIN biz_category c ON p.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN biz_merchant m ON p.merchant_id = m.id WHERE p.id = #{dto.productId} AND p.status = 1

SELECT id, sku_code, sale_unit, unit_weight, is_variable_weight, min_quantity, max_quantity, quantity_step, price, original_price, wholesale_price, stock, sales FROM biz_product_sku WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND status = 1 ORDER BY sort_order ASC, id ASC

SELECT spa.attr_id, a.attr_name, spa.attr_value_id, av.value AS attr_value FROM biz_product_spu_attr spa LEFT JOIN biz_attribute a ON spa.attr_id = a.id LEFT JOIN biz_attribute_value av ON spa.attr_value_id = av.id WHERE spa.product_id = #{productId} ORDER BY a.sort_order, av.sort_order
